theorems.name: Submission.coarea_null_slices_of_eilenberg
theorems.statement: (∀ (N m k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μHE[k] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ ((C * L ^ m : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[m + k] A) → ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (U Z : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → Z ⊆ U → μHE[m + k] Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) = 0
